literal: An unlearned man desiring speech is like she who lacks both breasts desiring womanhood.
translation: An unlearned person's desire to speak in an assembly is like a woman lacking both breasts desiring to exhibit womanly charms.
modern: கல்வி கற்காதவன் அவையில் பேச விரும்புவது, இரு மார்பகங்களும் இல்லாத ஒரு பெண் பெண்மையை விரும்பியதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet uses a sharp, vivid analogy to illustrate the futility of an uneducated person attempting to speak in public. The word 'காமுறுதல்' means desiring or longing for something. Just as a woman who lacks breasts cannot successfully embody or express physical womanly beauty, an unlearned person cannot command respect or deliver a meaningful speech in an assembly. The comparison highlights that without the essential underlying quality, the desire to perform the associated role is entirely in vain.
